label: GO step late in the episode (trial 85+) after an unrewarded trial, when the agent is choosing a1
explanation: Fires almost only at GO (99.6% of mass), only in the last ~15 trials of an episode (none before trial 78, 90% of mass in trials 90-99), when the previous trial went unrewarded (93% of mass) and the agent is about to pick a1 (96% of mass; choice logit strongly favours a1, value is low). It does not fire at D1 or D2, in early or mid episode, after rewarded trials, or on a2 choices. Magnitude grows as the episode nears its end and over runs of consecutive unrewarded a1 trials (strongest after rare-unrewarded a1 trials, where the agent stays on a1). The predicate uses only observed variables plus the agent own choice. Dev: P 0.52, R 0.77, F1 0.62, mass recall 0.91. Requiring choice > 5 instead of model_act==1 raises precision (F1 0.66, mass recall 0.85). Most false positives are weak late-episode GO steps after a single loss, so precision is limited: the feature looks like a graded end-of-episode, low-value, a1-commitment signal.
